# Star Groups

> Star Groups is a fast-growing Bengaluru-based business group operating across real estate, interiors, landscaping, technology, media, marketing and venture capital.

Star Groups builds and operates independent companies from Bengaluru, India. Each company has its own services and team while sharing the wider group's operational capabilities.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://www.stargroups.info/): Overview of Star Groups and its multi-sector businesses.
- [About](https://www.stargroups.info/about): Background, operating model and leadership of Star Groups.
- [Companies](https://www.stargroups.info/companies): Directory of all companies in the group.
- [Contact](https://www.stargroups.info/contact): Bengaluru office details and contact form.
- [Enquiry](https://www.stargroups.info/enquiry): Submit a project or partnership enquiry.

## Companies

- [Star Gardens](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/star-gardens): Landscape design, execution, maintenance and plants on hire.
- [Starline Solutions](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/starline-solutions): Shared operational and business support for group companies.
- [Star Production House](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/star-production-house): Commercial films, corporate media and post-production.
- [Star Tech India](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/star-tech-india): Websites, applications, software systems and WhatsApp CRM.
- [Star Spaces](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/star-spaces): Modular kitchens, wardrobes and smart residential interiors.
- [Star Growth Hub](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/star-growth-hub): Marketing strategy, creative production and performance growth.
- [Star Infra Developers](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/star-infra-developers): Residential, plotted and farmland property development.
- [MAC Reality](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/mac-reality): Real estate promotion, channelling partnerships and buyer advisory.
- [Star Venture Capital](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/star-capital-venture): Early-stage and growth investment with founder advisory.
- [Starline Import & Export](https://www.stargroups.info/companies/starline-import-export): Home and garden sourcing plus coffee and spice exports.
